description: The Codex app-server writes about 200 KiB to stderr, past the 64 KiB pipe buffer, then a line echoing the fake OPENAI_API_KEY the test sets in settings env, then exits 1. The reader must drain stderr and report the redacted tail.

stderr.line: codex app-server: stderr filler line to fill the pipe buffer past sixty-four KiB ..............

note: The value is the fake key the test puts in settings env; the tail must show [redacted].
